subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Should all OpenAI-compatible Responses providers be required to emit an official terminal event, and which of the two open implementations should become the canonical fix?
rationale: The strict terminal contract fixes the reported silent success but can reject nonconforming compatible providers, while the current and competing branches differ materially in scope and failure boundary.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Rebase and retain only terminal-state handling plus existing-harness tests, then add controlled HTTP/SSE interruption proof before merge.

options.title: Prefer the competing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 as the landing candidate only after it gains positive real transport proof and a clean maintainer review.

options.title: Accept the broad branch
options.body: Merge the additional image and tool-call processing changes only after explicit owner review and compatibility proof for those unrelated behaviors.

recommendation.title: Narrow this PR
recommendation.body: Rebase and retain only terminal-state handling plus existing-harness tests, then add controlled HTTP/SSE interruption proof before merge.
